# Northwind Refund and Return Policy

## 6. Digital Goods
All digital goods, downloadable software, and virtual licenses are non-refundable once delivered.

## 6.1 Video Courses
Video courses may be refunded within 7 days of purchase, provided less than 20% of the course has been viewed.

## 7. Perishable Goods
Perishable goods past 14 days are non-refundable, except if damaged upon delivery.

## 8. Definitions
High-value transactions are defined as orders exceeding $10,000 USD.
